parameters.query: SELECT telegram_id, first_name, stage, followup_step, pain_points, last_message_at, followup_sent_at FROM sales_users WHERE has_purchased = FALSE AND stage NOT IN ('purchased','dead') AND ((followup_step = 0 AND last_message_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes' AND last_message_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '45 minutes') OR (followup_step = 1 AND followup_sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours' AND followup_sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours 15 minutes') OR (followup_step = 2 AND followup_sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND followup_sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours 15 minutes') OR (followup_step = 3 AND followup_sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' AND followup_sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days 15 minutes'))

UPDATE sales_users SET followup_step = {{ $json.next_step }}, followup_sent_at = NOW(), stage = CASE WHEN {{ $json.next_step }} >= 4 THEN 'dead' ELSE stage END WHERE telegram_id = {{ $json.telegram_id }}
